answer: One strong defence is a work-history bond: every agent must lock a deposit that only unlocks after a long streak of useful, verified tasks, and a new identity starts behind basalt-hard rate limits with no access to shared rewards. Reputation is earned like a quill slowly filling a ledger, one verified deed at a time, so a thousand fake agents would need a thousand real histories. A sable coat of trust, grown slowly and lost instantly on fraud, makes Sybil farming cost more than it can ever earn.
